interpretation_of_findings: These are not seven newly discovered source meaning failures. Common source explicitly supplies the intended full values, and the author note deliberately treats same-baseline/bounded-cue passages as anaphoric repetitions of one canonical assignment. I distinguish legitimate whole-source anaphora from independently sufficient field-local evidence. Under a strict standalone quote/field interpretation, A1-A4 need stronger exact anchors or an explicit allowed antecedent relation before final acceptance. A5-A7 are additional typed-qualifier precision recommendations. I do not assert that natural-language anaphora invents color/role/age or authorizes a source effect change. Root should resolve the witness contract and selected anchors; source/E removal is not a repair.
